the development and implementation of methods to audit and mitigate intersectional bias in machine learning applications.
auditing and mitigating intersectional discrimination in machine learning models, which we believe is of paramount importance to make the use of such models more trustworthy.
the development of new methods to audit and achieve intersectional fairness in classification problems, with the aim of improving the quality of decision-making in the real world.

intersectional fairness is important and can be achieved with the proposed methods.

we introduce the concept of intersectional fairness, provide auditing techniques to detect intersectional discrimination, and present a post-processing technique that can be used to mitigate the bias.

we provide a set of tools to audit and achieve intersectional fairness in a classification problem, which can be used in any real-world application.
